newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 19.895 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 19.895 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Thursday, July 24, was fixed at 19.8950 percent, or a fall of 34.75 basis points from 20.2425 percent, the rate for July 23, Banco de Mexico said on Wednesday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day, and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Thursday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
The weekly revised 91-day TIIE rate fell 76.50 basis points to 20.4800 percent on Wednesday from 21.2450 percent the week before.
The 28-day TIIP rate, also revised weekly, meanwhile fell 116.73 basis points to 19.8456 percent on Wednesday from 21.0129 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
